name: purple-emperor
_about: A purple emperor (Apatura iris), a male 7 cm across the wings: dark brown wings that flash purple-blue in the light from their bases; a broken white band across both wings, white spots near the forewing's tip, a small orange-ringed black eye at the forewing's inner corner and another at the hindwing's; beneath warm brown and grey. A brush-foot (four walking legs). Basking, wings spread. Coat: the female (no purple, brown). Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/winged/butterflies.py on insectlib.py + wlib.py (each wing one sheet, its upperside's painting laid on it as thin sheets in layers -- the 2D butterflies' own paintings, assets/butterflies/; the wings beat in the variant "flying").
